headline: Account 2 did not land yesterday: 38 initials, the lowest weekday on record. Matt Webb's call is tomorrow.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Confirm Matt Webb for tomorrow, a confirmed call shows. Tag the two fresh replies: Ayman came in at 06:29 this morning, Robert Gutierrez last night. Fix mrplusmoney's row, the Booked Y was removed but Status still says Booked, so the sheet disagrees with itself, make it say one thing: rebooked with a date, or back to Talking. And chase the account 2 setup, yesterday ran on the main account alone.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: Initials against the new 105 bar: 38 yesterday is 36 percent of plan. Account 2 going live is the number that changes everything downstream. Second: cash, EUR 0 with 18 days left, Matt on Friday and Josh when his time is set are the shots on goal.
